{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id and highest sample_seq per patient
print("Number of rows before deduplication:", len(trial_df))

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
deduplicated_df = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print("Number of rows after deduplication:", len(deduplicated_df))

# Check if biomarker_final has any missing or sentinel values
print("Sentinel value (-999.0) count in biomarker_final:", (deduplicated_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check the distribution of biomarker_final
print("Summary statistics for biomarker_final:")
deduplicated_df['biomarker_final'].describe()"}
